stories.title: Machado fails to slip back into Venezuela while Rodríguez is away

en.title: Machado fails to slip back into Venezuela while Rodríguez is away
en.summary: A Venezuelan opposition leader attempted to return to the country three times within 24 hours but was unable to complete the journey home.

stories.title: 英首相が情報攻撃への対策機関を設置へ 国連演説で表明 ロシア念頭、英選挙に「干渉」

en.title: UK Prime Minister to Establish Countermeasures Agency Against Information Attacks; Announced in UN Speech with Russia in Mind, Election "Interference"
en.summary: UK Prime Minister Bahrnum announced at the UN General Assembly plans to establish a National Information Defense Center to detect, identify, and counter information attacks by hostile nations. The center aims to address Russian disinformation campaigns.

stories.title: Trump threatens to annihilate Iran as diplomats push for deal at U.N.

en.title: Trump threatens to annihilate Iran as diplomats push for deal at U.N.
en.summary: Trump made threatening statements toward Iran at the UN while diplomatic efforts continue to reach an agreement. Iran's Armed Forces dismissed Trump's comments as propaganda.

stories.title: 台風25号 千葉と神奈川で9人死亡 4人行方不明 住宅被害相次ぐ

en.title: Typhoon 25 Kills 9 in Chiba and Kanagawa, 4 Missing; Housing Damage Widespread
en.summary: Record rainfall from Typhoon 25 caused landslides and river flooding in Chiba and Kanagawa prefectures, resulting in 9 deaths and 4 missing persons. Numerous residential properties sustained damage.

stories.title: 米とイラン代表が協議 事態の打開につながるかが焦点

en.title: US and Iran Representatives Hold Talks; Focus on Whether Situation Can Be Resolved
en.summary: US and Iranian representatives conducted talks during the UN General Assembly, with Trump confirming the discussions occurred. A US envoy indicated the talks proceeded through intermediaries.

stories.title: J1川崎が小林悠の引退発表 歴代7位の144得点、2017年に最優秀選手賞

en.title: Kawasaki Frontale announces retirement of Yu Kobayashi with 144 career goals, 7th all-time
en.summary: Kawasaki Frontale announced that forward Yu Kobayashi, 39, will retire on January 1, 2027, having scored 144 career goals ranking 7th all-time. Kobayashi won the league's best player and top scorer awards in 2017 when Kawasaki won their first championship.

en.title: Japan-US leaders exchange views on China-related issues; Prime Minister Takaichi mentions ICC
en.summary: Prime Minister Takaichi held a summit with US President Trump in New York during the UN General Assembly to discuss various issues related to China ahead of an upcoming US-China summit, agreeing to strengthen coordination.

stories.title: 「ダチョウが走っている」と通報 飼育のエミューが逃げ出し、捕獲

en.title: Escaped farm emu reported as ostrich running; animal captured
en.summary: A captive emu that escaped from a farm was reported by someone who mistook it for an ostrich. The animal was subsequently captured.

en.summary: Typhoon Dujuan caused at least nine deaths and four missing persons in areas near Tokyo as of Wednesday morning, with Chiba Prefecture reporting six deaths and Kanagawa Prefecture reporting three.

en.summary: Indian battery cell manufacturers are reducing their growth targets due to deteriorating business relationships with Chinese partners.

en.summary: Residents of Indonesia's West Kalimantan region are facing severe air quality problems caused by extended fire activity and resulting haze.

en.summary: The Asian Development Bank reports that El Niño weather patterns and artificial intelligence developments are expected to increase economic disparities among developing Asian nations.
